scope: actual desktop clicks plus read-only API and fixture output checks
cases: edit comment and observe disabled approval until saved
approve v2 and poll to completed
view v1/v2 and approval digest in history
reload, refresh task list and reopen completed task
create another investigation and reject to cancelled
verify exact edited comment once and no outputs from rejected task
limitations: not an automated browser regression suite
no mobile, multi-browser or all error paths covered
